enrol.title: Apply
enrol.description: Apply to our community learning group for grades 1–4. An application is an expression of interest, not a confirmation of acceptance.
enrol.lead: An application is an expression of interest, not a confirmation of acceptance.
enrol.offer: Montessori-inspired community learning for children in grades 1–4. You can read about our approach on its own page.
enrol.grades: You can apply for grade 1, 2, 3 or 4.
enrol.next: After you send the application we will get in touch about the next steps. We are still working out the admission requirements and capacity.
enrol.processNote: This process is a proposal and has yet to be confirmed.

process.title: You get in touch
process.text: You fill in the application or write to us.

process.title: Introductory conversation
process.text: We call or write and go through your questions.

process.title: Getting to know each other
process.text: We arrange a meeting so that we can meet.

process.title: Agreeing on next steps
process.text: Together we decide how to continue.

enrol.privacy: We use the details in your application to handle it and to stay in touch with you. We do not ask for birth numbers or health details. You can read more in our privacy information.
enrol.closedHeading: We are not taking applications at the moment
enrol.closedText: If you would like to ask about next steps, write to us.
enrol.waitlistNote: We keep a waiting list. An application puts you on it, but it does not mean acceptance.

enrolSubmitted.title: Application sent
enrolSubmitted.confirmation: Thank you for your interest. We have received your application and will get in touch about the next steps.
enrolSubmitted.note: An application is an expression of interest, not a confirmation of acceptance.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Write to us, or arrange an introductory visit or meeting.
contact.lead: Write to us, or arrange an introductory visit or meeting. We will gladly reply.
contact.detailsPending: We are still confirming our contact details. For now, please write to us through the form.
contact.venuePending: We are still confirming the venue. We will publish the address and how to get there once they are certain.
contact.visit: Would you like to come and see us, or arrange an introductory meeting? Choose the subject “Introductory visit” in the form and tell us when would suit you.

contactSent.title: Message sent
contactSent.confirmation: Thank you, we have received your message. We will reply to the email address you gave.
